name: 60651 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60651 (Chicago) has 246 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60651 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 70 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
